2.t: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;

3.t: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;

4.t: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-

5.t: Verily that which ye are promised is true;

6.t: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.

7.t: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,

8.t: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,

9.t: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.

11.t: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:

12.t: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"

13.t: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!

14.t: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"

15.t: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,

16.t: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.

17.t: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,

18.t: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;

19.t: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).

20.t: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,

21.t: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?

22.t: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.

23.t: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.

24.t: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?

25.t: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."

26.t: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,

27.t: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"

28.t: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.

29.t: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"

30.t: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."

31.t: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"

32.t: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-

33.t: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),

34.t: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."

35.t: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,

36.t: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:

37.t: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.

38.t: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.

39.t: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"

40.t: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.

41.t: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:

42.t: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.

43.t: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"

44.t: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.

45.t: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.

46.t: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.

47.t: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of space.

48.t: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!

49.t: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.

50.t: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!

51.t: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!

52.t: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!

53.t: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!

54.t: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.

55.t: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.

56.t: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.

57.t: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.

58.t: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).

59.t: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!

60.t: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
